description: This file defines extension methods for configuring Azure Table Storage as grain storage in Orleans silo builders. It provides methods to add Azure Table Storage as default or named grain storage, and internal methods to register related services and options.

classes.name: AzureTableSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring Azure Table Storage in Orleans silo builders.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage as the default grain storage, with options specified via an action.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage for grain storage with a specified name and options.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Overload that configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage as default, with options specified via an OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorage
methods.description: Overload that configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage with a specified name and options via an OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainStorage (internal)
methods.description: Internal method that registers Azure Table Storage services and options into the dependency injection container.
